question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reduce**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reduce **means to make something smaller or lessen in quantity, extent, or degree. (किसी चीज़ को मात्रा, विस्तार या डिग्री में छोटा या कम करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The company implemented measures to reduce energy consumption and minimize its environmental impact.*
 
 
 
• In the given context, "reduce" means to lessen or mitigate the impact of climate change. 
 
• "**Reduce**" implies a proactive effort to decrease the release of pollutants that contribute to global warming.

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Exclude**: To leave out or not include someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु को छोड़ना या शामिल न करना)
 
• **Exaggerate**: To represent something as being larger, more important, or worse than it actually is. (किसी चीज़ को वास्तव में उससे बड़ा, अधिक महत्वपूर्ण या बदतर के रूप में प्रस्तुत करना)
 
• **Increase**: To make something larger in quantity, extent, or degree. (किसी चीज़ को मात्रा, विस्तार या डिग्री में बड़ा बनाना)
